relations.text: データセンターの需要をAmazon Web Servicesに委託している
relations.text_en: Outsources its data center needs to Amazon Web Services

source.quote: We outsource our data center needs to Amazon Web Services, or AWS.

relations.text: AWSやSnowflakeなどの第三者サービス提供元と契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Has agreements with third-party service providers such as AWS and Snowflake

source.label: Tenable 10-K
source.quote: Because our agreements with certain third-party service providers, such as AWS and Snowflake, limit their liability for damages, we may not be able to recover a material portion of our liabilities to our customers and third parties arising from issues with such
source.note: 契約上のリスク記載に基づくものです。
source.note_en: Based on a risk-factor description of the agreements.

relations.text: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.が管理代理人・担保代理人を務めるクレジット契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Has a credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent and collateral agent

source.label: Tenable 10-K
source.quote: In addition, our credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent and collateral agent, contains restrictive covenants that limit our ability to pay dividends on our common stock.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: 同クレジット契約は2021年7月7日付である
relations.text_en: The credit agreement is dated as of July 7, 2021

source.label: Tenable 10-K
source.quote: Credit Agreement, dated as of July 7, 2021, by and among Tenable, Inc., the lenders party thereto and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent and collateral agent.
